fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches user's bank accounts with caching mechanism
postconditions: Account data available for other operations
business_logic_steps: 1. Check if accountCachedData is not null
2. If cached data exists, return cached accounts
3. If no cache, call AccountApi.getAccounts() to fetch from API
4. Extract accounts list from Accounts wrapper entity
5. Check if result is null or empty, return empty list if so
6. Otherwise return the fetched account list

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches detailed balance information for a specific account
postconditions: Account balance data returned with all balance types
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher for network operation
2. Call AccountApi.getAccountBalance with provided accountId
3. API returns AccountBalance with nested balance objects
4. Return complete balance structure to caller
5. No caching or transformation applied
6. Direct pass-through of API response

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches user's personal information from identity service
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher for network call
2. Call UserApi.getUser() with authentication headers
3. API returns User entity with personal details
4. Return user data directly to caller
5. No caching or validation applied
6. Direct API response pass-through

fr24_capabilities.description: Downloads user's profile picture as base64 encoded string
postconditions: Profile picture data returned as string
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher for network operation
2. Call AccountApi.getAccountPicture with accountHolderId
3. API returns base64 encoded image string
4. Return string directly to caller
5. No image processing or validation
6. Raw API response returned

fr24_capabilities.description: Uploads a new profile picture file for the user
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher for file upload
2. Convert File to RequestBody with image/* media type
3. Call AccountApi.uploadAccountPicture with file data
4. API processes upload and returns response array
5. Return API response (nullable array) to caller
6. No local file validation or error handling

fr24_capabilities.description: Retrieves the account holder through the repository layer (AccountRepository.retrieveAccountHolder). Returns AccountHolder.
business_logic_steps: 1. Caller invokes AccountRepository.retrieveAccountHolder().
2. Repository dispatches work on Dispatchers.IO.
3. Network / cache interaction runs to completion.
4. Result (AccountHolder) is returned to the caller.

fr25_business_rules.description: Before upload the bitmap is re-oriented from its EXIF metadata so the server-side copy matches the device's capture orientation.
Network / disk work is hopped off the main thread via Dispatchers.IO to keep the UI responsive.
Null / missing collections are defaulted to an empty list so downstream UI code never has to null-check.
Image uploads build a MediaType tagged with an image/* content type so the multipart body is typed correctly for the server.
Background-thread results are delivered to observers via postValue so the emit lands on the main thread.
Account list is cached locally to avoid repeated API calls
